class.name: FmodEventAudioStream
class.experimental: This class was added to support sound themes in godot 4.8 the implementation is somewhat hacky so if you find any bugs open a github issue. For now FmodEventEmitter classes are the preferred way to play sounds using nodes but, in the future they may be deprecated to prefer AudioStreamPlayers and AudioStreams
class.brief_description: A class representing an Fmod Event
class.description: The FmodEventAudioStream class is a specialized [class AudioStream] for playing Fmod events.

members.member: The GUID of the event to play.
